Definition: Tebach, the name of a Mesopotamian
BiblicalUsage: Tebach was a son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by his concubine Reumah. He is named in the list of Nahor's children, among the sons who stayed in the east while Abraham went west.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sons of Nahor are part of the family story even when they stay behind, and Tebach's name is kept in the record.
